result.title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning
result.summary: Time-series question answering (TSQA) requires grounding linguistic queries and diverse answer formats in complex numerical observations. However, existing methods heavily overfit to specific datasets and struggle to generalize when input series, question contexts, and answer requirements shift simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TSHarness, an agentic framework that establishes a decoupled workflow for cross-dataset zero-shot TSQA. At its core, TSHarness divides and conquers numerical perception and contextual reasoning via a structured Time-Series Perception State (TPS). Guided by a reusable memory of analytical knowledge, a learned Tool Selector adaptively invokes numerical tools to extract salient statistical and temporal features into the TPS. The answering agent then performs semantic reasoning over the TPS to generate target outputs, triggering iterative re-perception through the feedback loop when evidence is deemed insufficient. By separating numerical feature extraction from question-specific reasoning, TSHarness eliminates the need for target-side training or answer feedback, providing a generalizable, cost-efficient foundation for zero-shot TSQA.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 TSHarness 智能体框架，用于跨数据集零样本时间序列问答：用时序感知状态（TPS）承载数值特征，由工具选择器调用数值工具抽取统计与时序特征，回答智能体再基于 TPS 做语义推理，并在证据不足时触发迭代重感知。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉模态，但其「感知状态 + 工具选择 + 证据不足触发重感知」的解耦结构与 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益成本、证据筛选和停止决策问题可直接类比，可供核查。
